Rewrite the integrand to expose the basic integration formulas: \[\tan^{3}{\left(\theta \right)} \sec{\left(\theta \right)}=\left(\sec^{2}{\left(\theta \right)} - 1\right) \tan{\left(\theta \right)} \sec{\left(\theta \right)}\]

Transform the expression and differential together. For the integral at this stage, the substitution is \[u=\sec{\left(\theta \right)},\quad du=\left(\tan{\left(\theta \right)} \sec{\left(\theta \right)}\right)d\theta\]\[\int \left(\sec^{2}{\left(\theta \right)} - 1\right) \tan{\left(\theta \right)} \sec{\left(\theta \right)}\, d\theta=\int \left(u^{2} - 1\right)\, du\]
